title: Club Assembly
summary: The meeting brought together 37 Rotarians and 5 spouses for fellowship and discussions on the club’s ongoing initiatives and future plans.
description: The meeting brought together 37 Rotarians and 5 spouses for fellowship and discussions on the club’s ongoing initiatives and future plans. Key areas covered included membership development, vocational service, healthcare, education, youth development and water conservation. The meeting highlighted the distribution of 45 wheelchairs, vocational and community service initiatives, and water projects aimed at creating sustainable community impact. Members also discussed the historic, largest-ever Rotary International Global Grant, valued at ₹6.5 lakh as mentioned in the meeting notes, along with upcoming activities and important Rotary engagements. The meeting reinforced the club’s commitment to service, collaboration and community development. Members were also informed about Jennifer Jones’s proposed visit on 30 November 2026.
